runs.purpose: DSB1 1 GeV stable retake (replaces mixed-config run 36)
runs.notes: James's note: re-run because pressures/collimators changed mid-run-36. Stable config throughout: 50,000 events in 27 minutes (~1850/min - the fixed beam config delivers ~30x run 36's pre-fix rate). Coincidence plateau 88.8% = 44,408 tagged e. Miss 57.7% (1 GeV material-scattering floor; run 36 overall was 66%). 12,575 timed electrons. cthr 100.

XCETs ~0.4 bar (single setting, e-only at +1/+3/+5). MODULE NOTE (corrected 2026-08-31): module is the standard shashlik W/LYSO:Ce tile stack; only the capillary set changes between campaigns. EJ-199 WLS absorption is tuned for LuO:Yb - spectrally mismatched to the LYSO:Ce 425 nm emission BY SPEC, so a to-spec EJ-199 should be nearly blind here. The observed response (~550 ADC-eq/GeV, slow) is in-beam support for the suspected Eljen contaminant (Notre Dame fiber testing) responding at 425 nm. Tag plateau 88.7% (17,732 e). Miss 69.5%. t-med 1367+/-24 ps.
